role: The ghast: a 4x4 flying nether mob that wanders by waypoints, tracks and bombards seen players with exploding fireballs, and drops gunpowder.

members.name: func_110182_bF

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: the fireball-from-player branch is dead (java's onEntityHit check can only fire for a player's own fireball, which the probe player never owns); the body is EntityLivingBase's. The player-shot fireball's 1000.0F kill and the shooter's triggerAchievement(ghast) run in ghasts.c gh_fireball_impact (an_world.achievement_hook, serverreplay.c sr_player_achievement).
